decoy_level_bootstrap.method: shared decoys resampled with replacement; actives fixed; 10,000 resamples; seed 42

active_level_bootstrap.method: actives resampled with replacement independently per target; decoys fixed; 10,000 resamples; seed 42

old_ci_issue: The old cross_species.csv bootstrap used isin() on resampled IDs, collapsing with-replacement multiplicity to a no-replacement subset; this corrected version keeps multiplicity.

reviewer_authoritative.note: old 0.5135-0.5433 was isin()-dedup artifact; point estimate 0.5288 unchanged

recommended_reporting: Use decoy-level CI 0.5033-0.5543 (reviewer-corrected); report as paired comparison of two targets/active sets, not cross-receptor transfer.
